import pandas as pd

# Read source tables
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_59/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_59/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on Mouse ID
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="Mouse ID", how="inner")

# Group by Timepoint and Drug, aggregate average Tumor Volume
grouped = joined.groupby(["Timepoint", "Drug"], as_index=False).agg({"Tumor Volume (mm3)": "mean"})

# Pivot so that each drug is a column, values are average Tumor Volume
pivoted = grouped.pivot(index="Timepoint", columns="Drug", values="Tumor Volume (mm3)")

# The target schema columns (except Timepoint) are drugs, some may be missing in pivot columns
target_columns = ['Capomulin', 'Ceftamin', 'Infubinol', 'Ketapril', 'Naftisol', 
                  'Placebo', 'Propriva', 'Ramicane', 'Stelasyn', 'Zoniferol']

# Ensure all target drug columns exist, fill missing with NaN
for col in target_columns:
    if col not in pivoted.columns:
        pivoted[col] = pd.NA

# Reset index to bring Timepoint back as a column
pivoted = pivoted.reset_index()

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
pivoted = pivoted[['Timepoint'] + target_columns]

# Write output
pivoted.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_59/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
